title: Show Tickets at Firelight Barn in Henderson
includes: Show Tickets to Firelight Barn Dinner Theater
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Las Vegas isn't the only place to find top-notch entertainment... Escape the flashy lights of the Vegas strip and head over to Henderson for an amazing, family-friendly show at the Firelight Barn! You'll enjoy live music entertainment featuring Mama's Wranglers, the Jackson Family Band. They have been performing together since 2001, and have even won awards such as "Young Entertainers of the Year". You do NOT want to miss out on a great night of fun for all ages!
